resources.string: An icon pack of live glass cards, each carrying the app\'s own mark.
Nova Launcher not found. Open Settings → Look and feel → Icon theme.
Lawnchair not found. Open Settings → Appearance → Icon pack.
Smart Launcher not found. Open Settings → Global appearance → Icon pack.
Pick “Live Takt” in your launcher\'s icon theme settings.
If your launcher is not listed
Open your launcher settings, find “Icon theme” or “Icon pack” and choose Live Takt. Apps without a hand-drawn icon still get a card: their original logo is placed on the glass backplate.
All icons are drawn from scratch. App names and logos belong to their owners.
